audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 read Sett and 2+ items read Skill, contradicting the page's own late-game text and the mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (poppy__sett) moved row 4 to Skill and row 6 to Poppy, leaving rows 3 and 5 on Skill. Keeper's Verdict answers The Show Stopper at 6, and her scaling resists take the last row.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side/win[4] to Skill and phases[6].side/win[6] to Poppy as matched pairs, ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 spike said Keeper's Verdict 'cancels your R The Show Stopper leap'.
audit.why: The Show Stopper is a 400-range carry-and-slam, not a leap. The kit marks Keeper's Verdict (140/120/100s) as a channel that makes her untargetable while she charges — that untargetability, not a cancel, is why your grab fails mid-channel.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], whys[4] and phases[4].why now state the untargetable charge and the 140s cooldown to bait.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings claimed Steadfast Presence 'negates your dashes' or 'eats your engage dash'.
audit.why: Sett has NO dash. Knuckle Down grants move speed toward champions; The Show Stopper carries a target. Her W stops enemy dashes — against Sett that clause never fires, and what actually matters is the armour and MR it gives, which increase as she drops low. Telling a Sett player to fear a dash-block teaches the wrong fight.
audit.corrected: spikes[0], spikes[3], late, early, whys[6], phases[6].why and wants.foe[1] now describe the resist steroid instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Charge described only as a 'wall-pin stun' with no numbers, and the passive shield was never mentioned.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is 475 range on 14/13/12/11/10s and stuns only if it pushes you into a wall — in open lane it is just a shove. Iron Ambassador gives her a temporary shield when she picks the buckler back up, which absorbs the front of your burst.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t rewritten with the real behaviour.

edits.before: Sett wins Level 6 by baiting Keeper's Verdict then committing R and Grit.
edits.after: Level 6 is skill — she is untargetable mid-channel, so bait Keeper's Verdict.

edits.before: Poppy takes over at 2+ items as W negates his dashes and R disengages his all-ins.
edits.after: Poppy takes over at 2+ items as her armour scales and R disengages every all-in.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Poppy doesn't want. Suplex her into your wave or tower, never into her own minions.
edits.after: The Show Stopper is online, but Keeper's Verdict answers it — she is untargetable while charging. Bait the 140s ult, then grab her.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Heroic Charge and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Her armour and MR scale with items and climb as she drops low, so a max-grit Haymaker is your only real damage. Commit on Keeper's Verdict's cooldown.

edits.before: You win early trades: E Facebreaker plus Q out-damages Poppy before her tank stats come online, but never dash or engage toward a wall — her W Steadfast Presence hard-stops your movement and her E Heroic Charge pins you to terrain for a stun.
edits.after: You win early trades: Facebreaker plus Q out-damages Poppy before her tank stats come online. Never fight with your back to terrain — Heroic Charge (475 range, 14s at rank 1) only stuns when it slams you into a wall, and her buckler shields her through your first burst.

edits.before: Respect her R Keeper's Verdict: it can knock you fully across the map or cancel your R The Show Stopper leap; bait it, and once it's down your Haymaker true damage plus Grit win the brawl.
edits.after: Respect Keeper's Verdict (140s at rank 1): she is untargetable while she charges it, so your grab cannot land mid-channel. Bait it out, then Haymaker and Grit win the brawl.

edits.before: Late game flips to Poppy: her W passively negates your dashes, her R disengages your all-ins, and full tank items let her frustrate your single-target profile in extended fights.
edits.after: Late game flips to Poppy: Steadfast Presence gives armour and MR that climb as she drops low, her R disengages your all-ins, and tank items blunt your single-target profile.

edits.before: You win the opening levels. Poppy is passive early and your E Facebreaker plus Haymaker true damage out-trade her before she stacks armor. The one rule: stay off walls, because her E Heroic Charge only stuns if it slams you into terrain, and her W can eat your engage dash.
edits.after: You win the opening levels. Poppy is passive early and Facebreaker plus Haymaker's true-damage centre out-trade her before she stacks armour. The one rule: stay off walls, because Heroic Charge only stuns when it slams you into terrain — in open lane it is just a shove.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay in your favor as long as you fight in open lane. Trade with E-Q-Haymaker and let Grit sustain carry the exchange. At 6, respect R Keeper's Verdict — it can launch you away or cancel your ult — so bait it out, then commit your R and burst her once her disengage is spent.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay in your favour as long as you fight in open lane. Trade with E-Q-Haymaker and let Grit sustain carry the exchange. At 6, respect Keeper's Verdict — she is untargetable while charging it — so bait it out, then commit and burst her once her disengage is spent.

edits.before: The matchup flips with items. Poppy's W Steadfast Presence passively negates your dashes, her R hard-disengages your all-ins, and full tank builds let her out-last your single-target damage. In extended late fights she frustrates you; play for tempo earlier and avoid drawn-out brawls near terrain once she's itemized.
edits.after: The matchup flips with items. Steadfast Presence stacks armour and MR that climb as her health drops, her R hard-disengages your all-ins, and full tank builds out-last your single-target damage. In extended late fights she frustrates you; play for tempo earlier and stay off walls once she is itemised.

edits.before: Use W Steadfast Presence to negate your Q and R dashes
edits.after: Use W Steadfast Presence armour as her health drops

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Poppy Steadfast Presence: Resists + STOPS enemy dashes nearby; grounds them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Poppy Heroic Charge (E, 475 range, 14s at rank 1): stuns only if it slams you into terrain. - Poppy Steadfast Presence (W, 20s at rank 1): armour and MR that climb as her health drops.

edits.before: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It only stuns against terrain. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Poppy wastes Heroic Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Force out her passive buckler shield before you cash Haymaker.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Heroic Charge: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. When it is down — E-stun + W her.
edits.after: Track Poppy's Heroic Charge: it stuns only against terrain. When it is down — E-stun + W her.

notes: The biggest correction here is that Sett has no dash at all, so Steadfast Presence's dash-block clause never applies in this matchup — four strings were built on that false premise. Keeper's Verdict's untargetable-while-charging behaviour comes from the kit's derived flags plus the mirror audit, not from Riot's one-line description ('Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away'), so it is stated as 'untargetable while charging' and nothing stronger. Whether Facebreaker can interrupt that channel before the untargetable window begins is not verifiable from the kit and is not claimed anywhere on the page.
